vegetable: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production mobile puzzle game background, portrait 1:2 aspect ratio, ideally 1024x2048. Theme: 田园菜篮 / garden vegetable basket. Cozy polished soft 3D clay-render casual game artwork seen from directly overhead, orthographic flat lay. Pale sage-green matte tabletop fills the entire image with very subtle texture and soft warm daylight. A small cropped wicker basket containing a carrot, broccoli and bell pepper only in extreme TOP LEFT corner; a folded cream and sage gingham cloth and small wooden garden scoop cropped at extreme TOP RIGHT. Tiny leaf sprigs only in bottom corners. Very sparse perimeter decoration. At least 80% of image is uninterrupted quiet tabletop. Keep the full central region x=15%-85%, y=12%-92% empty for a separate game frying pan and UI. Top decorations occupy at most 15% of height, bottom corner accents at most 6%. Decorations feel charming, rounded, tactile, pastel, not photoreal. No pot, pan, bowl, UI, frame, buttons, lettering, text, logo, watermark or characters. No scattered food in center. Full bleed opaque background, not transparent.
